The previous attempt failed only because the FigDown source wasn't wrapped in a fenced code block for the validator to find — the content itself was fine. Here it is properly fenced:

```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 block
title "Telemetry export pipeline"

block poller "Poller"
block normalizer "Normalizer"
block healthprobe "Health Probe"
block buffer "Ring Buffer"
block exporter "Exporter"

poller -> normalizer
healthprobe -> normalizer
normalizer -> buffer
buffer -> exporter
```
